'''Grav-units''' were used aboard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Asteroid Base]] used an intricate network of grav-units to assist in simulating standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
